notes:
What's new in 0.7
- Menu: tap ☰ on Home for New forms, Available forms, Drafts, Pending, Sent forms, Create a survey, Your forms, Templates, Import and Imported reports
- Offline banner: if the phone loses signal, an orange banner tells you to switch on data or Wi-Fi to send reports. Tap × to close it
- Status pill under your name: orange when online, gray when offline
- Profile picture on Home, in the menu and in Settings
- New forms and templates show a "New" pill until you tap them; tab badges count what you haven't seen yet
- Online forms show their publish date
